snippet.title: Cat Craft - Gameplay Update
snippet.description:
We're happy to share that we've significantly updated our Steam Page for Cat Craft! 🚀 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3942220/Cat_Craft/

We’ve been working hard to make sure our page truly reflects the cozy, magical vibe of the game.

Here is what’s new:
New Gameplay Video & Screenshots: See the core mechanics in full action - from growing ingredients and crafting cats to managing your cozy cat café.
Updated Game Description: Get a better understanding of what you'll be doing in Cat Craft!

We poured a lot of heart into this update and truly hope you love how the game is shaping up.
